'''2011 German National Championship Marcus Dutzeck DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marcus Dutzeck]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Marcus "The Flying Dutchman" Dutzeck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
